titles.title: Mass gap for the fractional Φ⁴₂ model

affiliation.name: Institute of Mathematics, Polish Academy of Sciences, Poland
Mathematical Institute, University of Oxford, United Kingdom

descriptions.description: We present a new, simple and self-contained technique for proving a mass gap for Euclidean quantum field theories in the high-temperature regime using the stochastic quantisation approach. As an application, we establish exponential decay of spatial correlations for the fractional $\Phi^{4}$ model on the plane in the Wick-ordering regime. The key idea is to analyse the propagation of perturbations using the linearised stochastic quantisation equation. Spatial propagation is controlled by an auxiliary random walk, while the potentially destabilising effect of the renormalised nonlinearity is controlled by combining dissipative energy estimates for the nonlinear dynamic with the Boué–Dupuis variational formula.
